BEFORE YOU START

Keep it simple.

  1. 01

    Open Kimi.

    Use this Kimi link and follow any account prompts shown there. This guide itself needs no account.

  2. 02

    Check your model access.

    Kimi confirms K3.1 Pro is available on its web and mobile products. Use it if your account offers it; check the options shown in your account. Official announcement ↗

  3. 03

    Start a new chat. Paste prompt 01.

    Fill in the bracketed details, then run the script, shot list, and caption prompts in order in the same chat. Read and approve each output before moving on.

This starter kit is free. It does not promise free K3.1 Pro access, unlimited use, or a trial. Check Kimi’s own account terms before using paid features.

THE 10-MINUTE PROJECT

One idea in.
A filming plan out.

Make a 30-second Reel. Use your own idea or load the example. These details fill the prompts below; nothing is sent until you paste a prompt into Kimi.

Your starting brief

Your brief stays in this page. Copy the prompts below when you’re ready.

  1. 0–2
    MIN

    Choose one useful idea.

    Fill in the brief. Pick something you can show with a phone, one location, and no extra crew.

  2. 2–5
    MIN

    Draft and approve the script.

    Run prompt 01. Read it aloud. Cut vague lines and check any factual claims.

  3. 5–8
    MIN

    Turn the script into six shots.

    Run prompt 02 in the same chat. Make sure every shot is practical and matches a line in the script.

  4. 8–10
    MIN

    Finish with the caption.

    Run prompt 03. Check the opening line, remove unsupported claims, and save all three outputs.

Ten minutes is a suggested drafting budget. Filming, editing, and Kimi’s response time are separate.

YOUR FINISH LINE

One approved script. Six filmable shots. One caption with a clear next step.

A couple of useful details.
Do I need to sign in to use this kit?
No. You can read, personalize, copy, and download everything here without signing in. Kimi is a separate service and may require an account or a plan for the model you want to use.
Are these finished videos?
The project produces a script, a shot list, and a caption. You still need to film and edit. The worked example in the ZIP is an editorial sample made for this guide, not a recorded Kimi session or a promise of identical results.
What if the first draft sounds generic?
Tell Kimi which line feels wrong and supply one sentence in your own voice. Ask it to rewrite only that section, preserve your verified facts, and keep the same time limit.
Where were the setup details checked?
Checked October 28, 2026 against Kimi’s official K3.1 Pro announcement and the Kimi web app. The announcement confirms web and mobile availability. This guide makes no free model access claim and avoids account-specific setup instructions.
